blocks.zh: 8.7 Microbial Control Design Considerations 8.7 微生物控制設計考量
Stagnation (停滯): still water = bacteria paradise. No flow = no shear force to prevent attachment, nutrients accumulate on surfaces.
blocks.en: Stagnation: still water = bacteria paradise. No flow = no shear force to prevent attachment, nutrients accumulate on surfaces.

blocks.zh: Temperature sweet spot (溫度甜蜜區 15-55°C): this is the "danger zone" for microbial growth. Most waterborne bacteria thrive in this range.
blocks.en: Temperature sweet spot (15-55°C): this is the "danger zone" for microbial growth. Most waterborne bacteria thrive in this range.

blocks.zh: Poor feedwater (原水品質差): garbage in, garbage out. High bioburden in feedwater puts enormous pressure on downstream treatment.
blocks.en: Poor feedwater quality: garbage in, garbage out. High bioburden in feedwater puts enormous pressure on downstream treatment.

blocks.zh: The key insight: use trend analysis (趨勢分析) to set YOUR system's alert and action limits based on actual capability, not just USP minimums.
blocks.en: The key insight: use trend analysis to set YOUR system's alert and action limits based on actual capability, not just USP minimums.

blocks.zh: 8.7.1 Regulatory Clarification to Common Industry Practices 8.7.1 常見產業實務之法規釐清
blocks.en: 8.7.1 Regulatory Clarification to Common Industry Practices

blocks.zh: Orientation (方向): Vertical preferred. Less dead volume, easier spray ball coverage, lower cost. Horizontal only when ceiling height is a constraint.
blocks.en: Orientation: Vertical preferred. Less dead volume, easier spray ball coverage, lower cost. Horizontal only when ceiling height is a constraint.

blocks.zh: Isolation (隔離): 0.2 μm hydrophobic vent filter is standard. For hot tanks, HEAT the filter to prevent condensation (wet filter = bacteria highway). Nitrogen blanket for CO2-sensitive or oxidation-sensitive products.
blocks.en: Isolation: 0.2 μm hydrophobic vent filter is standard. For hot tanks, HEAT the filter to prevent condensation (wet filter = bacteria highway). Nitrogen blanket for CO2-sensitive or oxidation-sensitive products.

blocks.zh: Turnover (周轉率): 1-5x per hour is the norm. Higher turnover = less stagnation = less biofilm risk. But under hot or ozonated storage, turnover is less critical because the storage conditions themselves are microbicidal.
blocks.en: Turnover: 1-5x per hour is the norm. Higher turnover = less stagnation = less biofilm risk. But under hot or ozonated storage, turnover is less critical because the storage conditions themselves are microbicidal.

blocks.zh: Drainability (排水性): Steam-sterilized systems MUST be fully drainable (condensate traps). Non-steam systems: drainability is GEP, not absolute requirement, as long as no stagnation occurs.
blocks.en: Drainability: Steam-sterilized systems MUST be fully drainable (condensate traps). Non-steam systems: drainability is GEP, not absolute requirement, as long as no stagnation occurs.

blocks.zh: 8.7.1.6 Deadlegs -- Critical Design Topic 8.7.1.6 死角管段 -- 關鍵設計議題

Positive pressure (正壓維持): If the system drops to negative pressure during peak usage, ambient air (with all its microorganisms) gets sucked in through any tiny leak. This is an "uncontrolled ingress" event -- essentially defeating all your upstream treatment.
blocks.en: Positive pressure: If the system drops to negative pressure during peak usage, ambient air (with all its microorganisms) gets sucked in through any tiny leak. This is an "uncontrolled ingress" event -- essentially defeating all your upstream treatment.

blocks.zh: 3 ft/sec minimum return velocity (最低回流速度): This provides turbulent flow (Re > 2,100) that creates shear forces on pipe walls, discouraging biofilm attachment. Below 3 ft/sec, laminar flow allows bacteria to settle and attach.
blocks.en: 3 ft/sec minimum return velocity: This provides turbulent flow (Re > 2,100) that creates shear forces on pipe walls, discouraging biofilm attachment. Below 3 ft/sec, laminar flow allows bacteria to settle and attach.
